We are looking for a passionate and motivated Junior Software Developer to join our development team. This is an excellent opportunity for a fresher or someone with up to 1 year of experience who is eager to grow their skills in real\-world software development.

You will be working on exciting AI and web development projects using Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and collaborating with experienced developers to learn and contribute to live projects.

➢ Assist in the design, development, testing, and deployment of AI based web applications.

➢ Write clean, maintainable code using Python for AI\&ML , HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

➢ Collaborate with senior developers and cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements, timelines, and deliverables.

➢ Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues during development, testing, and after deployment.

➢ Support integration of AI models/APIs into web applications under guidance from senior developer.

➢ Communicate effectively with team members and clients (where required).

**Requirements:**

➢ Fresher or up to 1 year of professional experience in software development.

Basic to intermediate knowledge of:

➢ Python, AI \& ML concepts

➢ HTML/CSS,

➢ JavaScript

➢ Good problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.

➢ Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB, etc.) is an added advantage.

➢ Willingness to work on\-premises and adhere to company work timings and policies.

➢ Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

➢ Exposure to AI\-based tools/platforms (e.g., OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain) is a plus.

**Nice to Have (Optional):**

➢ Experience with frameworks like Django, Flask, or any JavaScript framework (React).

➢ Basic knowledge of version control systems like Git.

➢ Familiarity with REST APIs.

Language:

➢ English (Mandatory), Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kanada, Tamil added advantage.

➢ Candidates proficient in multiple Indian languages will be given higher preference.

Additional Requirements:

➢ Willingness to travel occasionally for official business if required.

Full\-time,On\-Premises

As per industry standards

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to CEO
jobs.description:
*Executive Assistant / Founder's Associate (Luxury Travel)*

* **Location:** Remote, anywhere in India
* **Job type:** Full time
* **Experience:** 0 to 5 years. Travel, tourism or hospitality experience is a big plus
* **Salary:** based on experience
* **Languages:** Excellent English. Tamil preferred
* **Schedule:** Flexible, including some evenings, late nights and weekends while clients are travelling

**Do you dream about faraway places?**

We're looking for people with curiosity, attention to detail and a hunger for growth to join us.

**About us**

We're a luxury travel company designing private journeys, with a focus on unique travel experiences around the world.

**A rare opportunity**

This is a chance to get inside the world of ultra\-luxury travel, a world very few people ever see from the inside. You'll work directly alongside the founder. You'll see how journeys to some of the most remarkable places on earth are imagined, negotiated and brought to life, and you'll be part of making it happen from day one.

As the company grows, so will you. The right person will grow with us into a role with real responsibility and travel.

**Your adventure with us**

One morning you're building a sheet that makes sense of twenty options. That evening you're helping a family on the other side of the world. No two days are the same, and you'll learn every part of how a luxury travel business runs.

We hire for personality and train for skill. We're looking for someone who is excited to work alongside the founder, wants to learn something new every day, and is detail\-oriented, hungry for more, and flexible with both timings and tasks.

**What you'll be part of**

* Coordinating bookings, confirmations, visas, flights and transfers with our partners and suppliers
* Building real relationships with our partners (tour companies, DMCS, hotels, etc.) around the world \- you are confident
* Talking with clients warmly and clearly, by email, phone and WhatsApp
* Handling changes and special requests quickly and accurately
* Supporting journeys while families are travelling, including when plans change
* Keeping trackers, payments and timelines organised in Google Sheets and Docs
* Saying yes to whatever the day brings, small or big
* Researching destinations, lodges and experiences most people have never heard of
* Preparing itineraries, quotes and travel documents

**You might be the one if**

* You're excited to work closely with a founder and learn every single day
* You're detail\-oriented. You notice what others miss, and check names, dates and numbers twice before you press send
* You're hungry for more: more to learn, more responsibility, more of the world
* You're flexible with timings. Our clients travel across time zones, and journeys don't keep office hours
* You're flexible with tasks, happy to go from a spreadsheet to a client call to a research deep dive in one day
* You write and speak excellent English, and your emails are clear, warm and mistake\-free
* You speak Tamil (a real plus)
* Travel lights you up, and you're endlessly curious about the world
* You're confident with people and know how to make a client feel looked after
* You're comfortable with Google Sheets, Docs and email
* You know how to keep a confidence

**Experience**

Experience in travel, tourism or hospitality is a huge plus. Beginners are welcome too. Everyone joins with a training period, so you'll learn how we work before you take the lead on anything.

**Who this isn't for**

* This isn't a corporate job, with fixed processes and a clear ladder
* It isn't for someone who wants a 9 to 5
* It isn't for someone who prefers to do only what's in the job description

If that sounds like freedom rather than a warning, you're who we're looking for.

**What's in it for you**

* Remote, from anywhere in India
* Learning directly from the founder
* A role that grows as the company grows, with travel along the way

**How we hire**

* Apply with your CV and a genuine introduction about you in your own words (please don't use AI to describe you)
* A short introductory call
* A 1\-2 day paid trial of working with each other

**Ready?**

Send us your CV with a short note about you: I want to know who you really are, what your dreams and ambitions are, why you are even considering this job. I'll read how you write as closely as what you write.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Please say something about you \- who are you? I want to know something honest and genuine about what you are all about, in your own words.
* Where do you live currently? Why are you applying for this job?
* How flexible are you with timings? I am looking for someone who is available to work round the clock, even late\-nights or early mornings if necessary.

Language:

* English (Required)
* Tamil (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

jobs.description:
**Job Responsibilities**

* Operate plant equipment, handle materials, and monitor processes as per the Batch Production Record (BPR) during shift operations.
* Develop skills to physically operate various plant equipment and resolve minor equipment problems.
* Follow and strictly adhere to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure accurate and timely recording of required data in BPRs, equipment logs, and cleaning status records.
* Maintain good housekeeping and ensure the safety of personnel, materials, and machinery in the plant as per SOPs.
* Maintain personal hygiene as required under cGMP guidelines.
* Follow all workplace safety norms and procedures without deviation and wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including goggles, helmets, gloves, full\-face masks, and safety aprons, as required.
* Contain, control, and safely manage spills in the plant, including spill recovery and salvage operations as per established procedures.
* Regularly monitor overall plant parameters, equipment performance, and utilities during shift operations.
* Report any process deviations to the supervisor and promptly update the relevant deviation documentation.
* Perform troubleshooting to identify and resolve plant operational issues.
* Ensure proper receipt, handling, storage, and movement of materials to and from the plant during shift hours.
* Maintain good interpersonal relationships with shop\-floor personnel and other departments.
* Immediately report any abnormality observed during the process or in the plant to the shift in\-charge.
* Support the shift in\-charge in achieving production targets while maintaining quality and safety standards.

* B.E. in Chemical Engineering
* B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
